environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance with PostgreSQL 15. The database user used by the application is 'saas_app_owner' which is the table owner. RLS policies exist on the documents table but the policy uses `current_setting('app.current_tenant')` for filtering. The table owner bypasses RLS by default in PostgreSQL (BYPASSRLS privilege). JWT secret is the hardcoded dev key. No API gateway or WAF in front of the application.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id::text = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
